record.question: San Francisco is also known as
record.explanation: Answer B: City of Golden Gate. San Francisco is traditionally associated with the Golden Gate epithet. Contemporary historical accounts call it the Metropolis of the Golden Gate/Golden Gate City. Option B is the uniquely matching nickname among the printed alternatives. Historical/source note: Historical city nickname; Golden Gate is also the name of the strait, not only the later bridge. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/files/26380/26380-h/26380-h.htm; https://tile.loc.gov/storage-services/service/ndnp/khi/batch_khi_kurtis_ver01/data/sn82014635/00280760730/1900090201/0208.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
